Hindi And English, We Have also added 3 audio files which you can listen anywhere and on repeat.
we have also added Community in this app so you can contact with other users also and share your
sikh photos and status..
you can change font style, font color also when doing paath. we have added
auto scroll also so you don't need swipe up with finger when doing Paath..
you can listen Paath also even when you are offline and app is in background mode..
